sting.prompt: A single deep, warm medieval church bell strike ringing out and slowly fading, with one soft low hand-drum hit exactly on the strike; no melody, no chimes, no electronic tones, natural reverb, clean ending

bell-distant.prompt: A single medieval church bell ringing slowly far away across a sleeping town at dawn, soft and distant

bell-many.prompt: Several medieval church bells ringing at once across a city, overlapping, slightly out of time with each other

bell-close.prompt: One large heavy church bell tolling slowly, close and deep, evening curfew bell

quill-scratch.prompt: A quill pen scratching quickly on thick parchment

paper-unroll.prompt: An old parchment scroll being unrolled on a wooden desk

water-splash.prompt: Hands splashing cold water from a wooden basin onto a face

forge-fire.prompt: A blacksmith's forge at night: bellows pumping and a fire roaring up with crackling sparks

market-sizzle.prompt: Meat sizzling over an open fire with a busy medieval market murmuring in the background

crowd-laugh.prompt: A small street crowd laughing and jeering outdoors

crowd-street.prompt: A busy medieval street: overlapping voices, cart wheels on mud, a horse, pigs grunting, distant hammering

coins.prompt: A few old metal coins clinking in a hand

crowd-football.prompt: A rowdy crowd of young men shouting and running on a cobbled street, chaotic ball game

tavern-crowd.prompt: Indoor medieval tavern ambience: murmuring voices, wooden cups clunking, occasional laughter

gate-shut.prompt: Huge heavy wooden city gates swinging shut with a deep thud and an iron bar dropping into place

night-wind.prompt: Quiet night wind in an empty stone street, faint and eerie

door-shut.prompt: A small wooden front door closing firmly, latch clicking

mill-grind.prompt: A heavy stone grain mill turning slowly in a stone room: grinding stone on stone, a wooden beam creaking, a donkey's hooves walking in a circle on a stone floor

pumice-fall.prompt: Small light pumice stones and ash pattering steadily onto clay roof tiles and a stone street, with a low distant rumble underneath, outdoors
